description: This Java class represents account associations within the Fineract application. It maps relationships between loan and savings accounts, including linked accounts and their association types, within the domain model.

classes.name: AccountAssociations
classes.description: Represents associations between different account types (loans and savings accounts), including linked accounts and their association type, with methods to create and update these associations.

methods.name: associateSavingsAccount
methods.description: Factory method to create an AccountAssociations instance linking a Loan to a SavingsAccount with a specific association type and activity status.

methods.name: associateSavingsAccount
methods.description: Overloaded factory method to create an AccountAssociations instance linking two SavingsAccount objects with a specified association type and activity status.

methods.name: linkedSavingsAccount
methods.description: Getter method to retrieve the linked savings account.

methods.name: updateLinkedSavingsAccount
methods.description: Method to update the linked savings account reference.
